rules.reason: devops pack: `kubectl delete` is a high-blast-radius verb. Confirm the kubeconfig context, name the target resource explicitly (no wildcards), and document rollback before running. Override with `senkani pack uninstall devops` if you accept the risk.

devops pack: `terraform destroy` tears down every resource the workspace owns. Confirm the workspace selector, run `terraform plan` first, and have a documented rollback before destroying. Override with `senkani pack uninstall devops` if you accept the risk.

devops pack: `--context=prod` targets the production cluster. Split context selection from the operation so the operator can confirm intent (`kubectl config use-context prod`, then the operation) instead of chaining both into one line. Override with `senkani pack uninstall devops` if you accept the risk.
